risk_summary: The disclosure provides meaningful operational and revenue quantification, including phase completion percentages and water sales, but relies heavily on standard forward-looking caveats and broad macroeconomic risk language. Housing demand, mortgage rates, construction costs, supply-chain disruption, oil-and-gas customer volatility, and percentage-of-completion estimates are material uncertainties. Overall tone is cautiously constructive, balancing growth expectations with significant sensitivity to external conditions.
